selection: Two named solar PV stations; latest three actual source months July-September 2026.

field_mappings.site_name_source: 發電站名稱/Name of The Power Station
field_mappings.source_average_daily_generation_per_capa: 平均單位裝置容量每日發電量/Average of Each Unit Power Generatioon Per Day

interpretation.generation: Reported actual monthly solar generation kWh, copied without scaling or power integration. Primary official statistics, not modelled potential.
interpretation.capacity: Source installed capacity unit is kW, NOT kWp. Value preserved per month.
interpretation.interval: CSV year/month identifies monthly energy totals. Title mentions daily because last column is an average daily per-capacity statistic, not the energy total.
interpretation.timezone: Asia/Taipei is a geographic normalization convention requested for Taiwan calendar months. Source page/CSV does not explicitly declare timezone. Offset +08:00 boundaries were constructed, not copied source timestamps.
interpretation.period_end: Exclusive first day of next calendar month; constructed boundary, not measured timestamp.
interpretation.source_average_daily_generation_per_capa: Supplementary source statistic copied as reported. Header does not explicitly label unit. Likely kWh/kW/day is inference only; NOT a measured daily kWh record and not used to derive energy.
interpretation.site_identity: Solar PV stations only, including solar arrays hosted at other facilities. Lanyu Power Plant Solar Power Station is its named solar installation, not all host-plant generation.
interpretation.missing: No missing/nonnumeric energy or capacity values in selected records. No imputation, date-shifting, interpolation or rescaling.
interpretation.source_record_number: 1-based CSV record number, header is record 1; not physical line number if quoted multiline fields occur.

limitations: Gross-versus-net generation and meter calibration/settlement audit not verified.
Timezone is normalization convention, not source assertion.
No relationship to Maharashtra, Mira Road, local housing societies or resident consumption.
